name: Boogie Squad
description: Boogie Squad is a 10,000-piece collection of looping jelly-cel dance PFP GIFs on Robinhood Chain. Each dancer is stacked from six layers — stage, lights, cast, face, fit, and prop — then flattened onto one 12-frame GIF. Cats, frogs, blobs, birds, robots, and more. A side-step. A groove. One shared clock.
